desc: The Orlivane carving set includes five wooden-handle tools with SK5 steel tips in different shapes for linoleum printmaking and rubber stamp carving. Each tool is about 140 mm long. The set comes in a clear storage box. Carve away from your body and keep the tools away from children.
b: 5 BLADE SHAPES — Five carving tools with different tips for outlines, fine lines and clearing larger areas.
SK5 STEEL BLADES — SK5 steel tips cut linoleum, rubber stamp blocks and soft carving blocks.
WOODEN HANDLES — Plain wooden handles, about 140 mm (5.5 in) long, sit comfortably in the hand.
FOR PRINTMAKING AND STAMPS — Use them for lino prints, custom rubber stamps, cards and art class projects.
CLEAR STORAGE BOX — The five tools come in a clear box that keeps the tips protected between sessions.
